skill.name: blockrun
skill.description: Route selected AI tasks through BlockRun for paid model calls, image generation, live X search, wallet setup, and spending checks.
skill.summary: Use BlockRun to call paid external AI models, generate images, search X, and manage wallet spending.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static Ruby/shell backtick findings are Markdown formatting false positives, but the skill does include pip install commands and hidden wallet session storage. Semantic review found material risks from wallet-funded paid calls, unpinned SDK installation, and disclosure of prompts or files to external AI providers.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before every paid call, enforce a user-specified budget, and report spending after each call.
Pin blockrun-llm to reviewed versions, publish hashes or provenance, and avoid automatic upgrades during normal skill use.

remediation.issue: Sensitive data sent to external providers
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before external model calls, redact secrets by default, and document the providers that may receive task data.
Document session file permissions, cleanup steps, wallet recovery risks, and when the wallet address or QR code may be displayed.

semantic_findings.title: Autonomous Paid External Calls
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells the agent that it has a wallet and should pay autonomously for capabilities through x402 micropayments. This can spend user funds unless every paid action is explicitly approved and budgeted.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The text directly describes wallet-funded autonomous payments and gives executable spending examples. The context clearly creates financial risk if used without confirmation.

semantic_findings.title: Unpinned Third-Party SDK Installation
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs installation and upgrade of blockrun-llm with pip and grants Bash(pip:*) in allowed tools. Unpinned package installation can introduce malicious or compromised dependency code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The allowed tools explicitly permit pip commands, and the documentation names unpinned install and upgrade commands. This is a direct supply-chain execution path.

content.user_title: Use Paid AI Models Through BlockRun
content.value_statement: AI assistants sometimes need live X data, image generation, or a second model opinion. BlockRun provides wallet-funded calls to external providers with spending checks and model examples.
actual_capabilities: Initializes a BlockRun agent wallet through the blockrun-llm SDK.
Checks wallet balance, wallet address, spending totals, and call counts.
Calls external chat models from OpenAI, xAI, DeepSeek, and Google.
Enables xAI Live Search for X, web, and news sources with filters.
Generates images through the ImageClient examples.
Shows cost tables and budget tracking patterns for paid calls.
limitations: Requires the blockrun-llm package to be installed before use.
Requires a funded wallet on the Base network for paid provider calls.
Sends prompts or files to external providers when the user approves a call.
Pricing, models, and provider availability may change outside the skill.

use_cases.title: Add Live X Research
use_cases.description: Use Grok Live Search when a task depends on recent X posts or current public discussion.

use_cases.title: Generate Images From Prompts
use_cases.description: Create image assets through DALL-E or other supported image models when text-only tools are insufficient.

use_cases.title: Request Model Second Opinions
use_cases.description: Send a focused prompt to another LLM provider for review, comparison, or lower-cost processing.

prompt_templates.title: Check Wallet Status
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner wallet setup and balance check
prompt_templates.prompt: Use BlockRun to show my wallet address, current balance, and total spending so far.

prompt_templates.title: Generate One Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use BlockRun to generate one image of a clean product mockup. Keep the spend under 10 cents and report the final cost.

prompt_templates.title: Search Recent X Posts
prompt_templates.scenario: Current social research with spending control
prompt_templates.prompt: Use BlockRun with Grok Live Search to summarize recent X posts about this topic. Limit search results to five sources and cite the results.

prompt_templates.title: Compare External Models
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced multi-model review with a budget
prompt_templates.prompt: Use BlockRun to ask GPT and DeepSeek for independent reviews of this plan. Spend no more than one dollar and compare the strongest disagreements.

output_examples.input: Use BlockRun to check my wallet balance.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports the wallet address, the current USDC balance, and the spending total for the session.

output_examples.input: Use Grok Live Search to summarize recent X posts about a product launch.
output_examples.output: The assistant returns a short trend summary, source citations, the search result limit used, and the estimated spend.

output_examples.input: Generate one image with DALL-E and keep the cost low.
output_examples.output: The assistant requests or confirms the prompt, generates one image, shares the image link, and reports the final cost.

best_practices: Set a clear dollar budget before any paid provider call.
Ask for confirmation before sending sensitive files or private prompts to external models.
Report total spending and call count after each BlockRun session.
anti_patterns: Do not use BlockRun when the local assistant can complete the task without external paid calls.
Do not send secrets, credentials, or private customer data to external models.
Do not install or upgrade the SDK in a production environment without package review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an AI assistant to use BlockRun for paid model calls, image generation, live search, and wallet checks.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: The skill says BlockRun uses wallet-funded x402 payments instead of direct provider API keys.

faq.question: Can it control spending?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples show budget checks, spending totals, and guidance to stop when a user budget is reached.

faq.question: Does it send data outside my workspace?
faq.answer: Yes. External model and search calls can send prompts, files, or task details to outside providers.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The skill expects the blockrun-llm SDK to be installed and a funded wallet on the Base network.

faq.question: Is it safe for confidential work?
faq.answer: Use it only after reviewing data sensitivity, provider policies, package provenance, and wallet spending limits.
